name: egg-drop-3d
description: A playful 3D STEM egg-drop builder and physics simulator

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @eggdrop/shared && npm run typecheck -w @eggdrop/api && npm run typecheck -w @eggdrop/web && npm run typecheck -w @eggdrop/infra
scripts.test: npm run test -w @eggdrop/shared && npm run test -w @eggdrop/api && npm run test -w @eggdrop/web && npm run test -w @eggdrop/infra
